title: Static Travel
subtitle: A meditation on movement through stillness
summary: An architectural exploration of transportation infrastructure as cultural artifact, examining how the form of a carriage becomes a vessel for collective memory and urban narrative.

title: Reproduce Tradition
subtitle: Modular assembly and the persistence of craft
summary: A study of traditional modular construction systems reinterpreted through contemporary fabrication methods, balancing repetition with variation.

title: The Fusion
subtitle: Suspended structures and structural honesty
summary: An investigation into hovering and suspended architectural elements, questioning how structural expression can become the primary aesthetic language.

title: Reimagine Everydayness
subtitle: Finding the extraordinary in the mundane
summary: A reexamination of everyday spaces and routines through architectural intervention, proposing that small-scale modifications can fundamentally alter lived experience.
